rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun fused with emphatic particle
compound denoting division into seven portions
compound predicate with past passive participle

items.question: What definitive proportion and length characterize the specified form?
premises: The referent is identified as that very form.
The form is specified as consisting of seven parts.
The form is declared to have the length of a stalk.
items.inference: Therefore the specified form is definitively characterized as seven-part and stalk-long.
items.plain_english: That very form is indeed declared to be seven-part and as long as the stalk.
